g.text: A factorial experiment estimates main effects and interaction with replicated error

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Assigned full two-level factorial with two observations per cell and coded factors±1. Interaction creates nonparallel mean lines; effects are high-minus-

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: low contrasts and differ from regression coefficients by a factor of two. ANOVA partitions120 response-units² into32+72+8+8. Randomization, independent

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: constant-variance errors, and residual checks are needed for inferential use; no causal field experiment is claimed.
